metadata.title: Vintage Window Pane Grid Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A central 3x3 grid of window panes containing a fragmented portrait, framed by a heavy black border with top-aligned display typography.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist white space is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central 3x3 grid of window panes. Each pane contains a portion of a group portrait, creating a fragmented, voyeuristic effect. The grid is surrounded by a thick black border. Bold, high-contrast serif typography is positioned at the top, split into two distinct colors.
coreVisualRelationships: Grid-to-border ratio emphasizing the central window
Typography alignment to the top edge of the grid
Color contrast between white and cyan text against black
Fragmented subject continuity across window mullions

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered within a 3x3 grid, occupying approximately 60% of the total canvas area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central window pane containing the primary figure's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left typography, moves down into the grid, and scans the individual panes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black border surrounding the central graphic element.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark border and the brightly lit, slightly desaturated vintage photography.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Tightly kerned 'The Box Tops' in cyan
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-based distinction within a single typeface family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif and ball terminal aesthetic.
Provides the necessary weight and vintage feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3x3 grid of window panes against a solid black background. Inside the panes, place a vintage-style photograph of a group of people, ensuring the image is fragmented by the black mullions.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, high-contrast serif text at the top. The first half of the phrase should be white and italicized; the second half should be cyan and upright. Align the text horizontally above the grid.

verificationChecks: Is the text split between white and cyan?
Does the font have high contrast and ball terminals?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black border is thick and uniform.
Check that the text is legible against the black background.
Confirm the vintage photographic filter is applied to the grid content.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central 3x3 grid + Heavy black border + Top-aligned high-contrast serif typography.
